name: Watch Next Kolex06-Version
description: Kolex06-styled sidebar Watch Next queue for Seanime with drag-handle ordering and automatic AniList custom-list sync in queue order.
author: Kolex06
notes: Sidebar-only build. Open Watch Next from the Seanime sidebar. Drag rows by the handle, sync to an AniList custom list named Watch Next, and avoid AniList 429s by only updating changed entries with safer request pacing.

networkAccess.reasoning: Required to display the Watch Next icon and AniList cover images, and to sync the queue into an AniList custom list.
